features.name: Standalone conditional GGRF Joint EEG release
features.description: Data processing, graph construction, GGRF, Joint Transformer, Flow pretraining, no-transport downstream training/evaluation, documentation and tests
features.evidence: 2026-09-20: clean package built; 5/5 tests and synthetic end-to-end smoke passed; wheel built; harness 100/100. Original Joint field 97 state keys/393581 parameters and graph predictor 43 keys/125803 parameters are exact-compatible. Existing seed234 hidden and edge checkpoints converted to one portable checkpoint; four-real-dev replay had logit max error 5.31e-6 versus the original path.
